title: ai-doc-system configuration
description: Per-project overrides for the documentation gate. Every key defaults to the value in scripts/docs-config.mjs; an array key may instead be written as "<key>+" to append to that default rather than replace it.

tier.description: [prefix, kind]; the prefix is relative to docsDir and must end with "/".

docsDir.description: Directory holding the documentation tree, relative to the repo root.

rules.description: Per-rule severity overrides. Unknown rule ids are rejected by the loader.

evidenceRunners.description: Command names an evidence entry may start with.

evidenceRunners+.description: Runners to append to the default list.

tiers.description: Ordered [prefix, kind] pairs; first match wins.

tiers+.description: Tiers to append to the default list.

moduleRoot.description: Where per-module trees live, relative to docsDir.

platformKey.description: Reserved module key for everything cross-cutting.

modules.description: The closed set of product modules.

modules+.description: Modules to append to the default list.

requiredFields.description: Extra frontmatter fields a kind demands, keyed by kind.

vocabularies.description: Closed value sets for optional scalar fields, keyed by field name.

statuses+.description: Statuses to append to the default list.

tierStatus.description: Tier kind -> the only status its documents may carry.

exempt.description: Files exempt from frontmatter, relative to docsDir.

exempt+.description: Exemptions to append to the default list.

sentinels+.description: Sentinels to append to the default list.

allowedBasenamePrefixes+.description: Prefixes to append to the default list.

tierOrder.description: Kind order in the generated INDEX.md.

tierOrder+.description: Kinds to append to the default order.

indexSubdivide.description: Kinds whose INDEX.md section is split per area.

indexSubdivide+.description: Kinds to append to the default list.

referenceScanExclude.description: Git pathspecs excluded from the tracked-reference scan.

referenceScanExclude+.description: Pathspecs to append to the default list.
